statements.label: Theorem 1 (i)
statements.restatement: For U in U(4), the minimal negative mass nu(U) of a common signed representation sum_sigma w_sigma 1{sigma(I)=J} = |det U[I,J]|^2 equals rho(U) = max(0, max_{pi,eps} -(t_pi + eps d_pi)/4), d_pi evaluated at the minor-square response.

statements.label: Theorem 1 (ii)
statements.restatement: max over U(4) of nu = tau*, the positive root of 32 t^3 + 48 t^2 + 28 t - 1, 0.033721124434 < tau* < 0.033721124435, attained on O(4).

statements.label: distance corollary
statements.restatement: det(D_a + U D_b U*) = (1+nu) z+ - nu z- with z+-, in K = conv{z_sigma}; dist(det, K) <= tau* diam K. Not MOC.
